libraryDescription: Manage each game’s cache, or choose an installed game to add.
libraryBudgetHint: One pool per configuration, with no fixed game quotas. Least recently used data is replaced when the pool is full.
libraryManualHint: Add its folder if a game or app is not detected.
libraryClearHint: Clear removes only cached copies for that item. Original files stay intact. Close the game or app before enabling or stopping its cache.
libraryDifferentDrive: This version accelerates folders on D using the SSD on M.
libraryLegacyActive: The earlier single-folder cache is still running. Stop it before enabling library caches.
libraryInvalidFolder: Choose a full local folder path without traversal or stream names.
libraryFolderMissing: The selected folder was not found.
libraryBusy: Another cache operation is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
libraryDiscoveryTimeout: Finding installed apps took too long. You can add a folder manually.
libraryHostFailed: The cache host could not start. The original folder is preserved; check its status and restore it if needed.
libraryRecoveryRequired: Restore the interrupted item before changing the shared budget.
libraryResizeFailed: The cache allocation could not be changed. Other items were not started.
libraryTooManyActive: Up to eight items can have their cache enabled together.
libraryBudgetTooSmall: Allow at least 1.1 GB per active item, within the 25 GB total limit.
libraryNotActive: This item does not have an active cache.
libraryOperationTimeout: The operation is taking longer than expected. Check the item's status before retrying.
libraryChooseApp: Choose a game or app from the library.
libraryAlreadyActive: This item's cache is already enabled.
libraryOverlap: An active item already includes this folder or one of its parent folders.
libraryBudgetExceeded: The active allocations would exceed the shared budget.
libraryStopFirst: Stop this item's cache before removing it from the library.
libraryCloseApp: Close this game or app before enabling or stopping its cache.
libraryProcessCheckFailed: Could not verify whether the selected app is closed. No folder was moved.
libraryResidentHint: Sizes show the portions currently cached, not the original file sizes.
libraryNoFilesMatch: No cached files match your search.
librarySettingsDescription: Storage devices and the capacity shared by your games and apps.
librarySettingsHint: Choose games, inspect cached files and clear or stop each cache from the Library.
configDescription: Connect your HDD to an SSD and choose a shared cache capacity for its games.
configBudgetHint: Up to 25 GB per configuration. Games on its HDD share this capacity.
configRemoveHint: This stops its caches, restores the original folders and releases cached copies. Your original files and other configurations stay intact. Close its games first.
configSafetyHint: Your original files stay on the HDD. Stop a configuration before changing its drives.
configStopFirst: Stop this configuration before changing its drives. You can adjust its capacity while it runs.
configChooseDrive: Add a cache configuration for this HDD in Cache settings.
configInvalid: Choose valid devices and a capacity between 1.1 and 25 GB.
configInvalidDevices: Choose separate, healthy, writable HDD and SSD NTFS data volumes.
configDeviceMissing: A configured drive is unavailable. Reconnect it or choose another drive after stopping the configuration.
configDeviceChanged: The volume identity changed. Stop and edit the configuration to select the intended device.
configSourceInUse: This HDD volume already has a cache configuration.
configInsufficientSpace: The SSD cannot hold all configured budgets while preserving its free-space reserve. Reduce a budget or choose another SSD.
configTooMany: Up to eight cache configurations are supported.
configNotFound: The cache configuration was not found.
configChooseBudget: Edit the capacity of the intended configuration in Cache settings.
libraryUsesSharedPool: Uses the shared pool — no fixed quota
libraryLoadingHint: The first load copies game data to the SSD; later loads, including after restarting Windows, read it from the SSD. Files changed in between are reread from the HDD. Once the cache is full, long one-time scans are kept out.
configSharedSubtitle: One pool for all enabled games
libraryDataScopeIncludes: Includes only the selected data folder and its subfolders.
libraryDataOnlyHint: Keeps executables and anti-cheat outside the cache mount. Compatibility still depends on the game.
libraryWholeFolderHint: Includes executables. Some anti-cheat systems may reject this mode.
libraryDataNotFound: No suitable data folder detected. You can add a data folder manually.
libraryStopModeFirst: Stop this cache before changing its scope.
libraryDataUnsupported: No unambiguous supported data folder was found. Add its data folder manually.
libraryDataChanged: The discovered data folder changed. Stop and remove the saved game entry, then add it again before enabling its data cache.
libraryDataUnsafe: This folder is not a safe data-only target: it contains executable files, links, inaccessible entries or exceeds the inspection limit.
